title: CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.01710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. translated_title: CoEvolve：基于双向状态精化的“构建-编辑”式视觉定位
translated_abstract: 视觉定位旨在用边界框定位语言所描述的对象。大多数多模态定位模型将目标识别、空间推理和边界估计压缩为一次性的终端预测。自由形式的推理说明虽然使推理过程在语言上显式化，但并不一定能暴露可测量、可编辑的空间状态。因此，中间定位错误难以诊断和纠正，导致错误的区域选择和不精确的边界可能一直延续到最终的边界框中。我们提出CoEvolve，一个“先构建后编辑”的框架，将视觉定位分解为显式的状态构建和状态编辑两个阶段。区域演化强化机制将定位分析组织为渐进式的语义-空间轨迹，每一步推理都承诺一个显式的候选区域。双向去噪精化器将推理文本视为固定的语义上下文，并对轨迹的坐标进行精化……
tldr: CoEvolve将视觉定位分解为显式的状态构建与状态编辑两个阶段，通过区域演化强化生成渐进式语义-空间候选区域轨迹，并利用双向去噪精化器在固定语义上下文下迭代修正坐标，使中间定位错误可诊断、可纠正。
en_tdlr: CoEvolve decomposes visual grounding into explicit state construction and state editing, using Region-Evolution Reinforcement to build a progressive semantic-spatial trajectory of candidate regions and a Bidirectional Denoising Refiner to iteratively refine coordinates under fixed semantic context, making intermediate localization errors diagnosable and correctable.
